items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-09-01
items.q: The interviewee discusses Buzzy only in response to the interviewer's questions about a female banjo player. The interviewee states 'I've never have been to one in so many years' regarding the Mummers bands where Buzzy played, indicating no direct personal interaction or collaboration with Buzzy him

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. She didn't know what a Mummers band was.

Yeah. You use her how often now? Right now she's working three days a week. While Buzzy was out during the summer with the center stage or whatever it is. She was working six days a week for about two months.
Is she a strong banjo player would you say?
